 Zelensky reports strikes on Russian defense industry plant, air defense assets worth $70 million
 photo 
 01.11.2026 13:27 
 Ukrinform 
 Ukraine’s Defense Forces struck the Kamensky chemical plant in Russia’s Rostov region, which is involved in missile production, as well as a Pantsir-S2 air defense system and a command-and-staff vehicle of the S-400 Triumf system. The total value of the air defense assets hit is estimated at approximately $70 million. 
 President Volodymyr Zelensky announced this in a Telegram post , Ukrinform reports.
 “Our long-range sanctions have targeted the Rostov region. The Kamensky Combine, a Russian defense industry enterprise involved in missile production, was hit,” he said.
 According to Zelensky, Ukrainian forces also struck a Pantsir-S2 air defense system and a command-and-staff vehicle of the S-400 Triumf system.
 “The total value of the air defense assets struck is around $70 million,” the President stressed.
 He also thanked the personnel of the Security Service of Ukraine and other components of the Defense Forces involved in the operation.
 “We are justly defending ourselves against Russian aggression and doing everything to reduce Russia’s capability to continue it,” the head of state emphasized.
 Read also: Drones attack Lukoil refinery in Russia 
 As Ukrinform reported, operators of the SSU’s Alpha Special Operations Center neutralized 3,198 Russian troops in one week.
